en: The *Dhāraṇī Sūtra for Increasing Wisdom*,
translated by the Tripitaka Master Śīlagupta, Imperially Appointed Court Dispersing Grandee, Acting Director of the Court of State Ceremonial,
and Great Master of the Transmission of the Dharma, under Imperial Decree.
Thus have I heard.
At one time, the Bodhisattva Mahāmati was dwelling on the summit of Mount Sumeru.
At that time, various devaputras came to visit the Bodhisattva.
They surrounded him with reverence to listen to the Dharma.
At that time, there was a bodhisattva named Kumārarūpa,
who joined his palms in respectful salutation and addressed the Bodhisattva Mahāmati.
We only pray that, out of compassion for our sake,
you will proclaim the Wisdom-Increasing Dhāraṇī for all sentient beings who possess little wisdom, dull faculties, and are ignorant.
In order to cause them to hear [this] and increase their wisdom, the Bodhisattva Mahāmati then proclaimed this dhāraṇī, saying:
*Tadyathā | oṃ bījo bīja prajñāvartani jara jara meda vartani dṛdhi dṛdhi mṛti vartani svāhā*. At that time, the Bodhisattva Mahāmati...
Having spoken this dhāraṇī,
he addressed the youth Lakṣaṇa, saying:
"If there are sentient beings whose wisdom is dull and inferior..."
Those whose faculties and natures are dull and who forget much should arouse a heart of sincere resolve toward this *Vṛddhimati-dhāraṇī*, receiving,
upholding, reciting, copying, and making offerings to it.
This person will swiftly attain vast wisdom and clear mindfulness such that they never forget.
If one recites this mantra seven times,
or twice seven times, [the same result shall follow].
Consecrate three portions of water and drink them at the hour of the Rabbit (the morning).
Drinking in this manner every day for seven or eight months,
one will naturally be able to memorize a thousand verses daily.
Even without drinking water constantly, he was able to memorize five hundred verses daily;
his wisdom gradually increased and his faculties became sharp and keen.
At that time, the Bodhisattva Śiṣyaka...
And all devas and humans believed, accepted, and practiced it.
Thus ends the *Zenghui Dharani Sutra*.
